🔥 一半人的 Grok Bot 死在「每次对话重新自我介绍」，另一半死在「第一天就敢开全自动定时任务」。

今天不聊花哨的生活剧本，专扒 sibylcap、DYoung_AI、Zenshq、Max_XuY 晒出来的五件工程基建：记忆接线工 + Research Desk + 文稿幻灯双人组 + 跨IDE呼叫桥 + 任务晋升阶梯。把地基打牢，你的 Bot 才不会是个每天失忆的实习生。

1️⃣ sibylcap：记忆接线工（Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory，总星 174★）
- 甩掉向量库和 Embedding：基于本地文件与 SQLite FTS5 做持久化长记忆，五件套含 SDK（client 0.10.0）、CLI 0.6.0、MCP 0.4.0、Hermes 0.6.0 与 LangGraph BaseStore
- 一条命令接线：跑 `sibyl setup grokbot` 直接给 Grok Bot 挂上记忆并回显改动，同套命令也通吃 cursor / hermes / claude-code / codex，甚至能在 Agent 自己的 shell 里免终端安装
- 顺藤摸瓜代替盲搜：记忆条目之间带显式链接，Agent 顺着关系网查上下文；devdosomething 实测同样 10 个问题，检索从 15 次 / 约 6.6 万字符压到 12 次 / 约 2.8 万字符，少读约 58% 废话
- 先验货再上工：`sibyl doctor` 一键跑通启动、列工具、写入、召回、删除测试记忆全流程
🟢 可核验信号：五选里社区反馈最硬（~5050 阅读 / 50 赞 / 17 转），MIT 开源 Python 库总星 174★
⚠️ 踩坑：client 0.9.0 起记忆工具需激活账号；本地记忆同样是权限面，先跑通 doctor 再进生产。
源帖：https://t.co/ClN0nFZ7aB
GitHub：https://t.co/zsSO8pDKuP

2️⃣ DYoung_AI 掘金：Research Desk 工程合同模板库（cobusgreyling/grok-bot-templates，总星 52★）
- 专治汇报胡编乱造：直接套用 Research Desk 的现成 PROFILE，强制输出带引用的简报，把「主张、证据、分歧点、未查到项」明明白白拆开标注
- 粘贴即装不写长篇提示词：新建 Setup agent 粘贴 START.md 的 raw 链接，或直接把 PROFILE.md 拷进 Edit Profile 完事
- 49 个模板带准入打分：目录内置 Bot Ready 评分，除 Research Desk 外还有 PR Reviewer、Bug Reproduction、Chief of Staff、Inbox Triage 等单兵卡与工程小队模板
⚠️ 可核验信号：源帖曝光刚起步（~210 阅读），但 GitHub 仓库总星 52★（MIT）+ 在线目录可随时复制验货
⚠️ 踩坑：Setup 只负责拉取 PROFILE；官方建议第一周死守 L1「只起草不外发」，且注意底层模型与运行时的潜在计费。
源帖：https://t.co/K3euL8WAzO
GitHub：https://t.co/NzCz0Icv2c

3️⃣ DYoung_AI 同帖打包：文稿幻灯双人组（serenakeyitan/agent-org-chart，总星 52★）
- 拆开写稿与做片：用「101」双人平级编组——Comms Drafter 专职磨文稿叙事，Slide Maker 专职出幻灯结构，告别一个 Bot 既写不好字又排不好版的四不像
- 一句话抄走架构：直接喂给支持派生的平台一句 `Import 101 from https://t.co/ORAgHmNou3` 即可拉起两人小队
- 跨平台组织图目录：TypeScript 编写，除了 101 最小组，还收录客服、工程、创始人、游戏工作室、市场、SDR 等多行业编组，Grok Bot 与 OpenAI dots 通用
🟢 可核验信号：GitHub 总星 52★ / 16 forks（MIT），与上面的 Research Desk 刚好形成「单兵合同 vs 双人搭档」互补
⚠️ 踩坑：宿主平台必须支持自动创建子 Agent；别上来就抄整家公司的组织架构图，先拿 101 双人组试水。
源帖：https://t.co/K3euL8WAzO
GitHub：https://t.co/ORAgHmNou3

4️⃣ Zenshq：跨IDE呼叫桥（ZensHQ/call-grokbot，总星 0★ · 非官方 MCP）
- 从本地终端摇人：通过本地 stdio MCP 桥接，让你在 Codex 或 Claude Code 里直接列出已有的 Grok Bot、派发单次自包含任务、轮询增量回复或随时打断
- 带着老记忆干活：被呼叫的 Grok Bot 完整保留原有的历史对话、长记忆和已挂载工具，不用在 IDE 里从零调教新 Agent
- 免手填 Token：复用官方 Cursor CLI 的浏览器登录流鉴权，拒绝往 MCP 配置文件里明文粘贴密钥（需 Node 22.13+）
⚠️ 可核验信号：刚推上来的新库，当前总星 0★，也非官方出品；但作者今日仍在推新 commit，且放出了约 50 秒实机演示视频，纯工程向硬货
⚠️ 踩坑：它只呼叫现成 Bot 而不负责新建；底层走非官方未公开 RPC 随时可能变动，Linux/Windows 真机登录流尚未完全实测。
源帖：https://t.co/tmgIeYDmXS
今日更新帖：https://t.co/NyVaHF6SfA
GitHub：https://t.co/wI646qpT3N

5️⃣ Max_XuY：任务晋升阶梯（Task → Skill → Routine 纪律官，纯实战方法论无 GitHub 星标）
- 严禁跳级上定时：先把任务带着 Bot 手动跑通一遍（手跑）→ 下令「把刚做的存成名为 X 的 skill」→ 最后才许设「每个工作日早 8 点跑 X」的 routine；跳过第一步直接写 routine 是自动化翻车的头号死因
- 10 分钟浏览器录制：对付每周一的网页杂活，先用浏览器录制跑通一次（最长 10 分钟）让 Bot 起草出初版 skill
- 回放纠错逼它交代「猜的步骤」：用一句狠话加固技能——「用上周数据回放这个 skill，列出你每一步靠猜的地方，逐个问我确认」，把隐性幻觉当场揪出来
⚠️ 可核验信号：两条源帖浏览量仅几十，无星标可吹，但这套「手跑→skill→routine」外加「回放纠错」是五件套里最省学费的防翻车纪律
⚠️ 踩坑：哪怕回放纠错对账过了，涉及浏览器写操作与敏感提交的步骤，前期依然得留人工复核闸门。
源帖 A（晋升三步）：https://t.co/XqAfcim7Yt
源帖 B（录制回放）：https://t.co/cz987XBe1H

💡 五件套怎么串成一条流水线：
先用 Sibyl-Memory（1️⃣）把本地长记忆接好并跑通 doctor；接着去 grok-bot-templates（2️⃣）贴一张 Research Desk 单兵卡，或者从 agent-org-chart（3️⃣）拉起 101 文稿幻灯双人组；写代码时用 call-grokbot（4️⃣）从 Claude Code / Codex 直接呼叫这批带记忆的老 Bot 协同；最后严格按 Max_XuY 的晋升阶梯（5️⃣），走完手跑→skill→routine，中途用回放纠错抓出「靠猜的步骤」，确认稳了再升格成每日定时任务。先把工程规矩立住，再去谈全天候无人值守。

note_tweet.text:
I built a shopping app called Sweetcouch. It reached 10 million users, was backed by Sequoia, and was named among the Best iPhone Shopping Apps of 2016.

Then AI arrived, and honestly, we were clueless.

How do you put AI inside a consumer product? The easy answer is to bolt a chatbot onto the existing app. It’s a patchwork, and we decided to avoid any such temptation.

We decided to educate us on generative AI and spent a year learning it. Here’s what we discovered. Software follows rules we write into it. An AI-native product puts intelligence at the centre. AI-enabled is easy. AI-native meant rethinking shopping from scratch. It took us a year just to unlearn how we used to build.

A second realisation.
Most consumer AI and personal agents, like Meta Muse, OpenAI Dots, Instinct and Grok bots, are built to save you time. But shopping isn’t a chore for most women. It’s how they explore, unwind and express themselves.

So why would AI take that joy away? It should make it richer.

That’s why we built THINGS: a styling team of five AI experts.
→ Inspector finds niche shops and vets them
→ Editor curates your looks every morning and tells you why they suit you
→ ME shows any look on you before you buy
→ Ego teaches you what works and finds what your wardrobe is missing
→ Accountant hunts the best prices and flags shipping and return fine print

You don’t see the agents. You just enjoy their work.

THINGS is free to start. We’re rolling out in India first, then globally.

#ConsumerAI #AIAgents #FashionTech #GenAI #PersonalAgents

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗻-𝗦𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲 𝗔𝗻𝘀𝘄𝗲𝗿 𝘁𝗼 𝗖𝗹𝗮𝘂𝗱𝗲 𝗗𝘂𝗲𝘁 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗻𝗔𝗜 𝗗𝗼𝘁𝘀

You ask a chatbot for something. It answers. Then it stops and waits.

But real work doesn't fit in one question. A price you want to watch every day. A research job that takes half an hour. A report due every Monday.

That's why OpenAI launched dots in September and Anthropic launched Claude Duet in October: 𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗸𝗲𝗲𝗽 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘄𝗵𝗲𝗻 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗮𝗹𝗸 𝗮𝘄𝗮𝘆. Both run in the company's cloud, and you need their subscription.

AnyModelBot is an open-source (MIT) version of the same idea that 𝗿𝘂𝗻𝘀 𝗼𝗻 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗼𝘄𝗻 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝘂𝘁𝗲𝗿.

𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗶𝘁 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝘀

You create "bots." Each one has its own persona, its own default model, its own folder and its own memory.

You talk to them in the desktop app, or from WeChat, Feishu, Telegram, Slack or Discord.

They can:
• 𝗗𝗼 𝗯𝗮𝗰𝗸𝗴𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 𝘁𝗮𝘀𝗸𝘀: "compare GPU prices at three clouds" runs on its own and reports back in the same chat
• 𝗙𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗼𝘄 𝗿𝘂𝗹𝗲𝘀: "check this price at 8am, tell me if it drops below 200"
• 𝗨𝘀𝗲 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝘂𝘁𝗲𝗿: read and write files, run commands, click and type on your desktop
• 𝗥𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗲𝗿 𝘆𝗼𝘂: memory is plain Markdown files on your disk

𝗙𝗼𝗿 𝘂𝘀𝗲𝗿𝘀

It asks before it acts outside its own folder. There are three permission levels: read-only, its own folder (the default), and full access.

It has 𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗹𝗶𝗺𝗶𝘁𝘀 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝘁 𝗶𝗻: $1 per task by default, $0.10 per rule run, and $3 a month per rule.

It also has quiet hours (10pm to 8am) and a cap on how often it messages you first.

𝗙𝗼𝗿 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀

It's assembled from open parts: DeepSeek Harness runs the agent, magpie is the model gateway, and Cua Driver handles the computer use. It's TypeScript and Electron, with SQLite for storage.

The design rule comes from DeepSeek's dsh-superagent prototype: 𝘶𝘴𝘦 𝘢𝘴 𝘭𝘪𝘵𝘵𝘭𝘦 𝘰𝘧 𝘺𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘢𝘵𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯 𝘢𝘴 𝘱𝘰𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘣𝘭𝘦, 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘣𝘳𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘢𝘴 𝘮𝘶𝘤𝘩 𝘷𝘢𝘭𝘶𝘦 𝘢𝘴 𝘱𝘰𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘣𝘭𝘦.

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗵𝗼𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁

"Local-first" means your 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝘁𝘀, 𝗺𝗲𝗺𝗼𝗿𝘆, 𝗳𝗶𝗹𝗲𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗸𝗲𝘆𝘀 stay on your device. 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹 𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘀 𝗱𝗼𝗻'𝘁.

Every model request goes through Modelflare, a paid API gateway run by the same people. You pay per token. Modelflare keeps request logs. Using your own endpoint is documented as "𝗱𝗲𝘃/𝘁𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗼𝗻𝗹𝘆."

It's also 𝘀𝗶𝘅 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 𝗼𝗹𝗱 (v0.1.15, 652 stars as of Nov 2). Telegram, Slack and Discord work in DMs only. Computer use on macOS is in beta.

And it's not the first open-source agent like this. OpenClaw has been doing "an AI that really does things" since late 2025. AnyModelBot's angle is WeChat and Feishu, budgets, and the polite "only bother me when it matters" design.

𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘭 𝘧𝘪𝘨𝘩𝘵 𝘪𝘯 𝘱𝘦𝘳𝘴𝘰𝘯𝘢𝘭 𝘢𝘨𝘦𝘯𝘵𝘴 𝘪𝘴𝘯'𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘢𝘱𝘱 𝘢𝘯𝘺𝘮𝘰𝘳𝘦. 𝘐𝘵'𝘴 𝘸𝘩𝘰 𝘺𝘰𝘶 𝘱𝘢𝘺 𝘧𝘰𝘳 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘮𝘰𝘥𝘦𝘭 𝘤𝘢𝘭𝘭𝘴.
